title: The cleanroom is one level of the factory
caption: Air handling, processing and service infrastructure form a coordinated environment. This is a functional section, not a building blueprint.

nodes.label: Air handling
nodes.detail: Filters and conditions air supplied to the process floor.

nodes.label: Processing floor
nodes.detail: Tools and wafer handling occupy controlled space.

nodes.label: Subfab services
nodes.detail: Pumps, utilities and exhaust support the tools.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Control the environment closest to the wafer
caption: The carrier and tool enclosure provide additional boundaries inside the cleanroom. Garments alone do not control chemical contamination.

nodes.label: Wafer surface
nodes.detail: Particles and residues can damage device structures.

nodes.label: Carrier and tool
nodes.detail: Local enclosures limit exposure during handling.

nodes.label: Cleanroom
nodes.detail: Controlled air and disciplined work reduce contamination.

nodes.label: Facility
nodes.detail: Utilities and people must support the controlled environment.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: A wafer travels with a process record
caption: Physical transport and manufacturing records must remain synchronized. A carrier location alone does not establish that its wafers completed the right steps.

nodes.label: FOUP
nodes.detail: Protects wafers during transport.

nodes.label: Process tool
nodes.detail: Receives and processes the identified material.

nodes.label: Lot history
nodes.detail: Records the route, completed steps and disposition.

nodes.label: Dispatch decision
nodes.detail: Selects a valid next operation.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: The same tool types serve many layers
caption: The sequence returns to familiar operations as the structure grows. A wafer cannot skip the starting-surface requirements of the next step.

nodes.label: Deposit
nodes.detail: Add a film to the current surface.

nodes.label: Lithography
nodes.detail: Align and define the next pattern.

nodes.label: Etch
nodes.detail: Transfer the pattern into the target material.

nodes.label: Planarize and assess
nodes.detail: Prepare and measure the next working surface.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Process time sits inside a larger cycle time
caption: A lot waits between transformations. In a stable system, more work in progress at the same output rate implies a longer average cycle time.

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.detail: Wait for an eligible tool and compatible conditions.

nodes.label: Process
nodes.detail: The tool changes the wafer.

nodes.label: Transport
nodes.detail: Move to the next operation.

nodes.label: Measure or hold
nodes.detail: Check evidence and release the lot when appropriate.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Several constraints set useful output
caption: Installed equipment is valuable only when materials, staffing, maintenance and scheduling let it produce qualified wafers.

nodes.label: Available tools
nodes.detail: Maintenance and faults affect productive time.

nodes.label: Ready material
nodes.detail: The right lots and inputs must reach the tools.

nodes.label: Coordinated schedule
nodes.detail: Dispatch respects process routes and priorities.

nodes.label: Qualified output
nodes.detail: Completed wafers share the factory’s fixed costs.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.
